Meeting Date:                 9/21/2022
Sponsor(s):                    Misc. Transmittal
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 7-1 at 2525 N Milwaukee
                              Ave-App No. 21166T1
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                             ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Titie 17 ofthe Municipal Code ofChicago, the Chicago Zoning

Ordinance be amended by changing all the C2-2 Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial

District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 7-1 in the area bounded by


       Beginning at a line 413.57 feet southeast of the intersection of West Logan
       Boulevard and North Milwaukee Avenue as measured along the northeast
       right-of-way line of North Milwaukee Avenue and perpendicular thereto;
       the alley next northeast of North Milwaukee Avenue; a line 460.61 feet
       southeast of the intersection of West Logan Boulevard and North Milwaukee
       Avenue as measured along the northeast right-of-way line of North Milwaukee
       Avenue and perpendicular thereto; and North Milwaukee Avenue (TOB),


to those ofa B2-5 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District,


SECTION 3. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.




Common Address of Property:         2525 North Milwaukee Avenue
                           NARRATIVE AND PLANS
                    FOR THE PROPOSED TYPE 1 REZONING
                                                AT
                                    2525 N. Milwaukee Ave.
                                            32"'' Ward
The Applicant requests a zoning change from the existing C2-2 to that of B2-5 to bring the property
into zoning compliance and permit residential use. The existing 4-story building will be preserved
and redeveloped with 27 dwelling units which includes two (2) commercial spaces on the 1'''floor
which will consist of 2,350 sqft. Request is made to allow a conversion of a multi unit SRO use to
a residential mix use building. Building height to remain unchanged; No onsite parking will be
provided.

This establishment is described as:

  ZONING: B2-5
  LOT AREA:. 5,361 sqft (per plat of survey)
A. MINIMUM LOT AREA PER DWELLING UNIT: 198.56 sqft
B. FLOOR AREA RATIO: 3.43
  BASEMENT AREA (not count): 0 sqft
  1st FLOOR AREA: 4,642 sqft
  2"'' FLOOR AREA: 4,581 sqft
 3'^'' FLOOR AREA: 4,581 sqft
 4"- FLOOR AREA: 4,581 sqft
 TOTAL FLOOR AREA: 18,385 sqft
C. OFF-STREET PARKING: 0
D. SETBACKS
 FRONT SETBACK: ZERO (existing building)
 REAR SETBACK: ZERO (existing building)
 SIDE SETBACK: ZERO (existing building) North & South
E. BUILDING HEIGHT: 55 ft


    * Equitable transit oriented development section.
    100% parking reduction will require an administrative adjustment 100% reduction
    * Applicant will seek a variation to allow a reduction to the minimum lot area per dwelling
     unit standard as per section 17-13-1101-R
